description: The depositor artfletch publishes a GLB mesh of Charlton Auxiliary Pumping Station and its pier on the Thames in London. The description reports 263 ground-camera photographs and 326 drone photographs taken in August 2022 and processed in RealityCapture. This former wartime installation supplied extra river water for firefighting. Zenodo distributes the mesh and JPEG previews, free under CC BY 4.0, through an Objaverse and Sketchfab-derived record. The geometry can support heritage-asset documentation or inspection and visualisation simulations around a waterside structure. The underside of the pier was partly repainted where photographs could not be obtained. Scale, positional accuracy and current structural condition remain unknown; the mesh is not a calibrated hydraulic or structural model. No related catalogue record identifies this asset collection. The geometry and images were not downloaded.
